about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Learn more about my journey
about.p1: Hello! I'm Rairson Fernandes, a Full Stack Developer with experience in web application development using PHP, JavaScript, React and MySQL.
about.p2: I enjoy developing complete solutions, from backend to frontend, applying good programming practices, organized architecture and version control with Git.
about.p3: I am currently expanding my knowledge in .NET and C#, aiming to become a specialist in these technologies and develop even more robust and scalable applications.
about.p4: I am looking for my next opportunity to continue evolving as a developer and contribute to challenging projects.
